home.title: My campaigns
home.description: Create ad campaigns, submit them for review and track results.
home.pendingAccount: Your account is not verified yet. You can create a campaign and submit it for review — payment opens once it is approved.

campaigns.emptyDescription: Create your first campaign: pick slots, duration and share — the price is calculated instantly.

nextAction.submit: Add a creative and submit for review

pay.title: Choose a payment method
pay.hint: You will be redirected to the payment page. The campaign goes live automatically once payment is confirmed.

orders.title: Payments
orders.description: Payment history for all your campaigns.
orders.emptyDescription: Payments appear here once a campaign is approved.

rateCard.title: Rate card
rateCard.description: Slots, daily impressions and a price calculator.

register.title: Sign up as an advertiser
register.subtitle: Open an account to advertise to the MangaBox audience.
register.name: Brand or company name
register.passwordHint: Password must be at least {count} characters.

campaigns.title: What is the Campaigns section for?
campaigns.purpose: All your ad campaigns in one place. A campaign is an order that defines where on MangaBox your ad appears, for how long and with what share.
actions: Create a new campaign and see its price upfront
Filter by status: draft, review, live and more
Submit a campaign for review, or pay once it is approved
Pause and resume a live campaign
Open "Details" for creatives, stats and payments
campaigns.note: Flow: Draft → Review → Approved → Payment → Live → Finished. A campaign can only be edited while it is a draft or rejected.

orders.title: What is the Payments section for?
orders.purpose: The history of every payment made for your campaigns. Each record belongs to one campaign.
actions: See which campaign was paid, when and how much
Track payment status: pending, paid, cancelled, refunded
Find the amount and provider for accounting
orders.note: New payments start from the campaign itself — the "Pay" button appears once the campaign passes review.

rateCard.title: What is the Rate card for?
rateCard.purpose: Ad placements (slots) on MangaBox, their prices and daily audience. Estimate your budget here before creating a campaign.
actions: See where each slot appears and its CPM
Compare daily impressions
Use the calculator: pick slot, share and days to get a price
rateCard.note: Share is the portion of all impressions in a slot given to your ad. For example, 25% means one in four impressions.

settings.title: What is the Settings section for?
settings.purpose: Your company details and account security. Moderators and payment documents use this information.
actions: Update brand, legal name, tax ID and email
Change your password
settings.note: Changing the password signs out all other devices. Your phone number is your login and cannot be changed here.

form.title: How does the campaign form work?
form.purpose: Choose where, from when and for how many days your ad runs. The price is calculated from the rate card automatically — no need to enter an amount.
actions: Pick one or more slots and a share for each
Set the start date and duration (7–90 days)
Limit how many times a day one reader sees the ad
See the total price and estimated impressions below
form.note: Minimum order is 100,000 UZS. After saving, the campaign is a draft: add a creative and submit it for review.

overview.title: Overview
overview.purpose: Campaign parameters and price breakdown: which slots, how many impressions are guaranteed and the total to pay.
actions: Check duration, daily cap and frequency cap
See impressions and price per slot
Read the moderator's note if it was rejected

creatives.title: What are creatives?
creatives.purpose: A creative is the ad people actually see: brand name, title, text, button and link, plus an image if needed. A campaign without creatives cannot be submitted.
actions: Add a card or image creative
Upload a logo and image — size must match the slot
Disable or edit a creative
Check how it looks in the preview
creatives.note: With several creatives, they rotate and you can compare which performs better in the stats.

stats.title: What do the stats show?
stats.purpose: Campaign results by day, slot and creative.
actions: Impressions — times the ad was rendered
Views — times the ad stayed visible for at least 1 second
Clicks and CTR — share of people who clicked
Unique viewers
stats.note: Data updates with a delay of a few minutes.

campaignOrders.title: Campaign payments
campaignOrders.purpose: Payments created for this campaign only, with their status.
actions: Check that a payment went through
See the transaction ID
